column2: #daily price drop (%) from the previous adjusted close; up days count as a 0% drop
#baseline volume: average of the PREVIOUS 20 trading days (lagged so today's
#volume does not inflate its own baseline)
volume_baseline = lag(rollmean(Volume, k = 20, fill = NA, align = "right")),
#volume multiple: today's volume relative to the baseline (NA if baseline is 0)
#sell-side volume spike: the multiple only counts on a down day
#Level 2 -> price drop 3%-7% or volume multiple 1.25-2 (inclusive), nothing past Level 3
#predictors are lagged one day (yesterday's indicators predict today's risk),
#otherwise today's rsi/macd/obv already contain today's price drop and volume spike.
#predictors are also standardised since obv, Volume and net_loss are on huge scales
across(c(rsi, macd_hist, macd_signal, net_loss, obv, Volume, Adjusted),
#shares_outstanding is left out - it is NA before fiscal 2019 (see note above)
